cands.name: Robin Bartleman
cands.bio: Democratic state representative for HD 103 since 2020. Educator and former assistant principal; Weston city commissioner (2000-2004) and Broward County School Board member (2004-2020).
cands.local_ties: District covers Weston, Pembroke Pines, Southwest Ranches, Miramar, Sunrise and Davie; Weston officeholder (Wikipedia).

record.text: Passed bills including Miya's Law (apartment security), Serena's Law (HB 1229, 2021), a blue-lights bill for large government trucks and a flood-control study (HB 513).

endorsements.text: Endorsed Democrat Mike Friend in HD 102 (not her own race).

cands.gaps: Her own money and endorsements not researched. Owner-source search (Stew Peters / Alex Jones / Owen Shroyer) not run for this candidate: the research tool's search budget was exhausted before it could be run. No hits is NOT confirmed.

votes.what: Joint resolution putting Amendment 3 (Save Our Homes property-tax changes: higher homestead exemption, lower assessment-increase limits) on the Nov 2026 ballot.
The 2025-26 General Appropriations Act (state budget), final vote.
Immigration enforcement bill from the 2025 special session: state cooperation with federal immigration enforcement.
Post-hurricane emergency management bill that also limits local governments' ability to adopt stricter development rules after storms.
Online Protections for Minors: restricts social media accounts for minors.
Interests of foreign countries: restricts land purchases near military sites and critical infrastructure by people from China and other 'countries of concern'.
Education: expands school voucher eligibility to all Florida K-12 students.
Heartbeat Protection Act: bans most abortions after six weeks of pregnancy.
Public Safety: lets most adults carry a concealed firearm without a permit (permitless carry).
Property Insurance: creates the Florida Optional Reinsurance Assistance program (FORA) for insurers.
Building Safety (condo safety response after Surfside).

cands.name: Imtiaz Mohammad
cands.bio: Republican, about 60. Pakistani-born (came to the U.S. in 1991, citizen since 2015); he and his wife run a multi-site salon business. Former Democrat who switched to Republican in 2022. Lost 2018 Democratic primary for Congress, 2020 House race and 2024 state Senate race.
cands.local_ties: Broward County; runs a salon business; prior runs in Broward districts (Florida Politics).

record.text: Has not held elected office. Prior results: lost to Jared Moskowitz by nearly 58 points in the 2018 Democratic primary, to Juan Fernandez-Barquin by 30.6 points in 2020, and to Jason Pizzo by 16.4 points in the 2024 Senate race.

money_notes.text: Has raised no outside money for this race; relied on a $2,000 self-loan to pay the qualifying fee.

controversies.text: At a December 2018 panel he said 'America is run on hate' and criticized the media and American people; he told Florida Politics he stands by the statement, saying he meant divisions among communities.
